approval_policy: source-only CI never authorizes an IPA or stage exit; human review and exact device evidence required

stages.name: Chuẩn hóa repo / baseline / PR
stages.exit_criterion: Merge/review #7 then #4 then #9 then #8 with all integration CI green; preserve v12 fingerprint

stages.name: Hook game-frame, ABI và trusted Online identity
stages.exit_criterion: Actual device logs confirm exact-v12 frame callback, authenticated local/host/session/peer identities, fail-open

stages.name: Authenticated transport / 32-player session
stages.exit_criterion: Two real endpoints exchange opt-in/heartbeat, reject spoof/replay/stale host, session lifecycle tested

stages.name: Police vertical slice on two iPhones
stages.exit_criterion: Two devices confirm police duty, target human player, cuff/uncuff and reset with real game log

stages.name: Police escort, jail and release
stages.exit_criterion: Two-device state machine including zone, timer, migration, replay and local controls verified

stages.name: RP touch UI, HUD, Vietnamese
stages.exit_criterion: iPhone/iPad UI and input test with no regressions to Pause, Menyoo or Story Mode

stages.name: EMS and taxi careers
stages.exit_criterion: Player-to-player revive/fare workflows, host authority, replay tests and two-device evidence

stages.name: Economy, inventory and persistence
stages.exit_criterion: Idempotent ledger, durable storage, migration/rollback and offline/replay tests

stages.name: Security, memory, performance, regressions
stages.exit_criterion: Device test matrix, stress 2..32, crash/memory/FPS logs, no unresolved release blockers

stages.name: Signed IPA candidate and manual release
stages.exit_criterion: Authorized baseline, exact build/sign evidence, device smoke tests, rollback, human approval
